_meta.description: Complete extraction of the Silkbind Jade lvl-110 speed-rotation workbook: every non-empty cell of all sheets (cached value + formula + type), plus translated structured views.
_meta.file: 牵丝玉110阶三合一竞速轴属性毕业率进阶计算器1.2.xlsx
_meta.localCopy: excels/Silkbind Jade lvl110 speed-rotation calculator v1.2.xlsx
_meta.variant: 三合一版 (three-in-one): one rotation sheet covering the Stonesplit Rift, Spring Thunder and Year After Year inner-way choices
_meta.author: BiliBili@片雲 / dy@雪皇
_meta.generatorTracked: No — scripts/ is gitignored, so the generator is not in the repo. Regenerating this extraction means writing it again from the local copy of the workbook.
_meta.devOnly: Contains Chinese verbatim — must never be imported from src/ or tests/ (CLAUDE.md: the app is English-only). The curated app-facing subset is silkbindJadeSkillCoefficients.wb1.2-lvl110.json.

_translation.method: enSource='official' means the exact key exists in reference/locale/zhToEnOfficial.json (official ZH<->EN pairs from the game client); 'inherited' means the label was already rendered by the Stonesplit Strength, Bellstrike Umbra or Bellstrike Splendor extraction and that rendering is reused so a shared label cannot diverge; 'composed' means it was built from official component terms plus spreadsheet shorthand; 'untranslated' means the Chinese is kept because the client DB has no key for it.
_translation.changelogNote: 更新日志 descriptions are free prose with no official keys and are kept in Chinese verbatim, untranslated by design.

C2.v: 重构了计算器Pro版本,因为有xlookup函数,建议用WPS打开.

C3.v: 数据更新至6月12日先琢版本

C4.v: 可能有小bug,但不会差很多

C5.v: 轴为苍假象轴,默认风墙全自动蹭断不蹭-4.4%,实际dps应低于计算面板2-3%

C7.v: 短时战斗断石大于春雷,易水必带

C8.v: 将所恨年年从尘增益区划入公共增益区以观测实际RD

C12.v: 微调了轴,用扇～+强化派生替换龙卷+普通派生,+0.5%

C13.v: 更新蕤宾叠奏上半数值,将铁花替换成了无惧

C14.v: 轴变更为拏云蛇慢气轴

C15.v: 增加了鸣金影提供的rd,约0.4%

C16.v: 单体增>全武,阴阳不如用2个骑龙替换2个龙卷

C17.v: 气竭保证不谢花覆盖的情况下全力奇术

C18.v: 气竭放风墙以外的非奇术技能不如换个武学

C19.v: 满血叶龙=2套拳,在不满血且精元溢出的的情况下使用叶龙替换2套拳能多10万

C22.v: 精元利用率:五拳=1.2骑龙=2拉矢

C23.v: 由于奇术占比大幅提升,当前版本小外玉满值约领先0.1%,下半会被大外反超

C24.v: 且不存在满值可能,所以默认依然为大外

C28.v: 断石、春雷、所恨三合一版

C29.v: 春雷和所恨毕业率均以断石满蹭为100%毕业率，所以毕业率较低

C30.v: 因为是单体轴，所以单体收益较高，会与正常情况有所偏差，不必在意

C31.v: 更新蕤宾叠奏下半数值

C32.v: 更新虎孟极快气轴，此轴为玉玉鬼脑之幻想进队拉爆队友轴

C33.v: 去除了机制时间的所有对小怪输出,并在计算dps时移除了机制时间

C34.v: 二气叶龙可能会导致伤害溢出
